explain.en: Speech-recognition models downloaded by OpenAI Whisper. Whisper downloads a model again the next time it is used.
explain.zh: OpenAI Whisper 下载的语音识别模型。下次用到时 Whisper 会重新下载。

notes: load_model(download_root=...) lets a program pick its own folder; that is invisible from disk. Missing or damaged files are downloaded again (checked by SHA-256 in _download). Not present on the maintainer's Mac.
